messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency > 2s for /v1/completions in eu-west-1. SLO burn detected (p95->420ms, p99->2100ms) — automated page triggered to oncall.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: page fired to @alex (oncall). Incident key: PD-INC-1795. Escalation in 5m if unacked.
alex: acked. looking. any obvious recent deploys? :eyes:
mona: no prod deploys in the last 30m from CI. saw a spike in batch sizes on the inference side in metrics.
ravi: checking autoscaler and queue depth now. throwing dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/infa/rows?panel=latency-eu-west
alex: logs show many sidecar retrys and heavier KV cache misses:
```
ERROR inference-serving: tail latency 2150ms model=redwood-compact v=2026-03-10 shard=eu-west-1
WARN kv-cache: miss rate 72% prefix=customer-A
```
mona: can we temporarily divert eu-west traffic to dedicated fallback model (redwood-compact-small) while we triage? That one is in the same family but lower mem.
ravi: routing policy ready. will flip a weighted-route 80/20 to fallback for 5m test. doing `curl -X POST https://routing.internal/route -d '{"from":"/v1/completions","region":"eu-west-1","weights":{"redwood-compact":0.2,"redwood-compact-small":0.8}}'`
alex: flipped. observing. metrics -> p99 dropped to ~1.1s after ~60s. p95 stable at ~380ms. good signal. :thumbsup:
mona: also reducing batch size on hot pool from 8->4 to reduce head-of-line blocking. command pushed to runtime: `PATCH /api/pools/hotpool?batch_size=4`
jen: planning to scale up an extra warm GPU node group in eu-west as the longer-term mitigation while we investigate root cause. starting `k8s scale` now.
cs-lead: heads up — CS reporting a couple customers in EU seeing delayed responses; no data loss. flagging for postmortem impact statement.
alex: next steps: 1) keep route diversion for 15m, 2) watch p99, 3) gather hotpool heap metrics and kernel traces, 4) if p99 climbs back, failover region or increase dedicated capacity.
mona: I'm collecting KV cache TTL/eviction traces and request distribution by prefix. will attach logs to the incident ticket.
ravi: autoscaler started 1 node, warm pool up in ~2m. current p99 ~900ms, p95 350ms. last_message_ts set when next handoff happens.
jen: wrapping up for my shift in 28m — handing off if things look stable. @alex take primary until then, will escalate to infra if we see preemptions.
alex: noted. keeping an eye, will escalate if >3% request errors or p99 > 1500ms for 5m. updating incident ticket PD-INC-1795 with mitigation steps.
cs-lead: will prepare customer comms draft in standby.
jen: handoff planned to @mona at 2026-03-18T02:15Z if no regressions. :white_check_mark:
thread_summary: Automated p99 latency page in eu-west-1; oncall acked, traffic partially routed to fallback model and batch size reduced. Warm pool scaled up; p99 improved from ~2.1s to ~0.9s. Customer-success notified for comms. Handoff planned if stable.
